description: Get branded intro clips ready to post, without touching a single slider. Upload your brand assets, images (PNG, JPG, MP4, MOV, up to 200MB), say something like "create a 5-second intro with my logo and a fade-in animation", and download 1080p MP4 when it's done. Built for YouTubers, content creators who move fast and want a professional intro without hiring a motion designer.
